FADE IN:

scenes.heading: INT. BOARDING SCHOOL - SCIENCE CLASSROOM - FLASHBACK

lines.text: AN OIL PORTRAIT
Of a REALISTIC but SEVERE-LOOKING OLD MAN seated in a high-
backed chair, surrounded by books, a German Shepard sitting at
his feet and the caption: “Atley Hades Longborough, Founder” and
the motto: “Institutum Superior Omnibus.”
The motto of the Longborough School for Boys
was “Institutum Superior Omnibus” or
“Tradition Over All.”
FIND TEN uniformed BOYS, lined up against the classroom wall,
YOUNG NED at the end of the line.
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
But on this morning, whether it was the topic of
flight, or the brandy in the teacher’s parlor...
THE TEACHER stands before a few large, simple teaching diagrams
labeled “FLIGHT,” showing a cross section of a wing with force
arrows, da Vinci-type diagrams, sketches of various birds and
artificial wings, etc.
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
...Mr. Gault threw tradition to the wind and let
the students choose their own lab partners.
EIGHT of the boys BOLT to the first few rows of desks. Young
Ned is left standing, searching.
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
Young Ned, however, found his chosen for him.
He walks to the LAST EMPTY SEAT in the back, where sits EUGENE,
a young Indian boy WEARING ELABORATE ORTHODONTIC HEADGEAR.
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
Eugene Mulchandani was an exchange student
from Gorakhpur, India. The orthodontic head-
brace served to correct an extreme overbite
borne of thumb-sucking.
Eugene’s headgeared mouth forms an awkward smile. Young Ned
hesitantly sits down. TWO MEAN BOYS at the desk in front turn
around and SNICKER.
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT ONE 2.
CONTINUED:
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
Young Ned felt a gnawing pit growing in his
stomach. As was tradition.
Eugene begins working fast with some sheets of paper from his
notebook...
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
But beneath Eugene's headgear thrived an
active imagination and a useful gift for
aeronautical model building...
Eugene pulls two small rubber bands from his teeth, continues to
work on his unseen project. We HEAR a balloon inflate...
As well as the hope that someone might not
dislike him for the simple fact that he was
different.
An impressed Young Ned watches as Eugene turns back around and
presents an intricate paper model of a dirigible gondola
attached to a helium balloon. Eugene lets go and the model
FLOATS UP INTO THE AIR. Then Ned sees:
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
Young Ned found himself breaking with his own
tradition, and, in a moment of passion...
One of the mean boys aiming a pea shooter (made from a straw) at
the balloon. Before he can get a shot off--
NO!
...he fought back.
Ned throws a “HISTORY OF FLIGHT” TEXTBOOK at the mean kid’s
head, preventing the popping of the airship. The teacher looks
up, GLARES at the mean kid (not seeing what Ned did).
The mean kid looks back at Ned: He’s gonna get it...
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
For the first time since his father dropped
him off 11 weeks, 3 days, 7 hours and 29
minutes before...
Grass and tree(s). Young Ned and Eugene stand ten yards away
from a HUGE PILE OF DEAD LEAVES.
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT ONE 3.
CONTINUED:
Young Ned made a friend.
Eugene RUNS TOWARD THE LEAF PILE and JUMPS IN. Ned laughs,
loving it, as Eugene stands and re-makes the leaf pile.
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
His newfound happiness overwhelmed him.
It’s Ned’s turn. He takes off running.
We go SLOW-MOTION as YOUNG NED JUMPS INTO THE AIR AND CRASHES
DOWN. AS THE LEAVES ENVELOPE HIM...
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
In the surge of emotion, he forgot his mother
had died, his father had left him and that he
missed a girl named Chuck.
The PILE OF LEAVES, with Young Ned in the middle, BECOME ALIVE-
AGAIN AS THEY TURN VIBRANT AND GREEN.
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
He also forgot he was jumping into a pile of
dead leaves that were once alive...
PUSH IN ON YOUNG NED
His smile fading as he realizes what happened. He looks to...
EUGENE
His face both confused and horrified. Young Ned tries to cover
with a confused shrug, but Eugene turns and runs away...
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
Eugene Mulchandani fled in a flurry of saliva
and fear.
Young Ned looks around to make sure no one else can see him,
THEN MOVES HIS HANDS THROUGH THE PILE AGAIN; the leaves he
touches BECOME DEAD-AGAIN, BROWN AND BRITTLE.
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
Eugene would eventually forget Young Ned’s
mistake and chalk it up to magic leaves. But
Young Ned would never forget that happiness born
of passion is always short-lived.
Young Ned looks up. His face falls...
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT ONE 4.
CONTINUED: (2)
ANGLE - THE TWO MEAN BOYS look down on him. One punches his
fist into his own palm. As they LUNGE, the CLOUD OF LEAVES
WIPES US TO--
NED, looking as if he has just remembered what we just saw,
waits by the toaster. CHUCK ENTERS--
Yet, through no fault of his own, he had once
again stumbled into happiness.
Good morning.
Which terrified him.
Waffles pop out of the toaster, giving Ned an audible STARTLE.
Morning.
As he puts them on her plate, and the two sit, eat...
Guess what today is?
(proud of himself)
World Hello Day.
I see you finally put up my Calendar of
Obscure Holidays.
Yes, and ho-la.
(then)
That’s Española.
Through the CIRCLE WINDOW BEHIND THEM, we see OLIVE opening up
the Pie Hole, wiping down the counters, etc....
Merhaba, seh-LA-maht PAH-gee, Oh-see-OH.
(then)
That’s Turkish, Indonesian and Cherokee.
Although the Indonesian meaning is more “good
day,” which is such a better greeting. What
does “hello” really mean, except, “Here I am,
your turn to talk”? I think it’s selfish.
(MORE)
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT ONE 5.
CONTINUED:
(off his smile)
What?
Nuthin’.
The meaning of “nuthin’” was, “Wow.” The Pie-
Maker wished to express to Chuck exactly how
intense his feelings for her were. But as no
suitably-powerful word existed, he impulsively
did the next best thing...
Am I your boyfriend?
Chuck looks up at him, girl interrupted. Olive, DEAD CENTER in
the CIRCLE OPENING, STOPS, listening...
Huh?
(nervously)
And I realize “boyfriend” and “girlfriend” are
familiar, trite labels. If convention were
something you soaked in, “boyfriend” would be
dripping with it. But we’ve never actually said
it. And not that we need to define the
relationship, but it might be helpful in a
familiar, trite way. The way on a holiday
invented to sell greeting cards it’s still nice
to get a card... And are you gonna cut me off
with a “yes” anytime soon--
Yes.
They grin at each other over the baking table. Olive is frozen,
looking crestfallen until Chuck and Ned turn, noticing, and she
instantly returns to work, as if she heard nothing.
You never told me what today is.
It’s my daddy’s birthday. He would have been
sixty today, if he were still alive.
Chuck smiles. PUSH IN ON NED:
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT ONE 6.
CONTINUED: (2)
The mention of Chuck’s father sent the Pie-
Maker’s thoughts spinning.
What’s wrong?
Nuthin’.
The meaning of “nuthin’” was, “I never told
you that I inadvertently killed your father.”
Ned sees EMERSON ENTER the Pie Hole. Uneasy, Ned starts toward
the front as Chuck bends to get something...
Emerson said he’s got a case that’s easy
money. I need to...
Chuck stands up holding the opened roll of plastic wrap over her
lips for a kiss, but he’s gone...
Ned?
Sad to be left hanging, Chuck sets back down the wrap...
OMIT

scenes.heading: INT. PIE HOLE - DINING AREA - CONTINUOUS

lines.text: Olive spins on a stool as Ned looks around the mostly-empty Pie
Hole...
Olive!
Yessir!
OLIVE’S POV
Olive Snook had told the Pie-Maker she was
happy for his happiness with the girl named
Chuck. But upon hearing the word “boyfriend,”
she unexpectedly found her sadness spinning
into anger. It was a truth she could not yet
stare in the face.
She comes to a DIZZY STOP to an OFF-CENTER NED.
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT ONE 7.
CONTINUED:
NED REMAINS OFF-CENTER in the WIDE LENS over:
Where are all the customers?
OLIVE
(looks around)
You got me.
(tips, dizzy)
Whoa...
ALFREDO (O.S.)
I am a customer.
ALFREDO
Alone in a booth, his chest of wares on the table. Olive
swivels to see him...
Her dizzy heart missed another truth staring
her in the face.
Alfredo, when did you come in?
(happy to remember)
Before. When you opened the door for me. And
I asked how you were, and you said you were
fine. And I asked for a macchiato, and you
said, “Coming right up.”
A small smile as he takes her in...
So I guess you still want that?
Yes, please.
He watches as Olive hops off, slightly off balance, moves toward
the espresso machine.
BOOTH
Ned and Emerson talk. Emerson reads the paper, sips coffee...
This case is easy money.
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT ONE 8.
CONTINUED:
You told me that already.
(then)
It’s my fault Chuck’s father’s dead.
You told me that already.
I should just tell her.
That idea would make a stupid idea feel better
about itself.
I can’t keep lying to her.
You’re not lying. The only way you’re lying
is if she asks the question, “Did you kill my
father when you brought your mother back to
life which I don’t know about because you
never told me?” Don’t tell her.
ANGLE - THE FRONT DOOR
As BILLY BALSAM, 30s, enters with the strangely-rehearsed and
annoying enthusiasm of a 7-year-old boy or an infomercial--
Hey, have you guys heard? There’s the most
amazing new candy store opening up down the
block! It’s amazing!
They stare at him a beat...
Who are you?
I’m just a guy who’s telling people about it
because it’s so amazing! Seriously,
everybody, you have got to check this out.
(hushed, to Ned)
This’s how it all ends. Some weird dude comes
in saying something that don’t make any sense.
And just as your head goes, “That weird dude
don’t make any sense,” your guts are all over
the window.
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT ONE 9.
CONTINUED: (2)
Do you work for the candy store?
No. I’m just some guy.
(incredulous)
“Some guy”?
Some guy who sure loves candy! Tell everyone
you know. See ya!
And he’s gone. Emerson and Ned share a look as Chuck arrives,
busy tying on her kerchief, adjusting her sunglasses--
You ready?
(sweetly teasing)
Did Ned tell you he’s my boyfriend?
Ned casts a nervous look to Emerson, who chuckles...
You guys are gonna love this case.
The facts were these...
TINA AND TONY’S REFRIGERATOR
SLOW PUSH IN ON A FOUR-CELL PHOTO BOOTH PICTURE STRIP
On the refrigerator with a “Tony & Tina 4eva” magnet. FOUR
DIFFERENT SILLY POSES of a young couple in love: TONY DiNapoli
and his girlfriend TINA Arongino.
One Tony DiNapoli, who chose to refer to
himself as The Italian Stallion...
CAMERA LANDS ON THE FIRST PHOTO:
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
26 years, 9 weeks, 2 hours and 10 minutes old...
PAN DOWN TO THE NEXT PHOTO:
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
...was found strangled to death in his
friend’s apartment.
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT ONE 10.
CONTINUED:
PAN DOWN TO THE NEXT PHOTO:
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
His girlfriend, Tina Arongino, was arrested at
the scene for the murder the police described
as a typical “crime of passion.”
PAN DOWN TO THE FINAL PHOTO: TINA IS ALONE, not so happy.
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
She proclaimed her innocence...
IN THE PHOTO: TINA SPEAKS--
I friggin’ loved Tony! You gotta help me,
Emerson Cod. I didn’t do it!
As the sheet-covered body slides out before our Mod Squad. He
has two clear strangle handprints on his throat.
With the evidence stacked against her, Tina
Arongino hired Emerson Cod.
Ned pulls back the sheet, starts his stopwatch and touches Tony.
We see the familiar POP of electricity as Tony springs to life.
‘Sup?
(eyes Chuck)
How you doin’? I’m Tony.
Chuck giggles. Ned gestures to the strangle marks.
Um... Do you know how you’re doing?
(feeling at his neck)
I’m dead, right? Son of a bitch.
Your girlfriend murder you?
Hell no. Me and Tina were mad for each other.
She friggin’ loved me.
You swear a lot.
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT ONE 11.
CONTINUED:
You’re hot.
Chuck giggles.
TONY (CONT’D)
It was Burly Bruce Carter strangled me.
Emerson’s looking closely at the strangle marks, carefully lifts
a french-tipped fingernail out of the skin...
“Burly Bruce” have congenitally dainty hands?
These strangle marks are from a petite female
with rounded, crimson French-tipped nails.
That’s ‘cause he used his girlfriend’s hands
to kill me.
The Mod Squad looks at Tony, unsure what to do with this...
I don’t know what to do with that.
Clock’s ticking.
His girlfriend’s a doll.
(smiles, to Chuck)
Not like you’re a doll, ‘cause you are.
(to the others)
She’s a doll-doll. Like, life-size and plastic.
She’s not a real person?
Bingo, pussycat. But don’t tell that to
Bruce. That was my mistake.
BRUCE leads Tony into the room. An elegant table for four has
been set up -- white tablecloth, flowers...
TONY (V.O.)
Bruce invited me and Tina over for a double
date. I got to Bruce’s place before Tina did.
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT ONE 12.
CONTINUED:
Sitting at the table is a life-size doll, dressed in a floral
skirt. Bruce gestures, introducing Tony to his new girlfriend.
Off Tony’s confused, “What the fuck?” expression... TIME CUT TO:

scenes.heading: INT. BURLY BRUCE’S APARTMENT - FLASHBACK - MOMENTS LATER

lines.text: Tony sits across from Bruce and the doll, laying into Bruce...
TONY (V.O.)
When he showed me the doll and said it was his
girlfriend, I let him have it, ‘cause you
know, it was a doll.
Unable to take anymore, Bruce suddenly grabs the doll’s hands
and LUNGES across the table (the doll’s top half separating from
its legs), tackling Tony backward.
TONY (V.O.)
Then he kinda flipped out.
As Bruce uses the doll’s hands to strangle Tony...
BACK TO SCENE
Emerson and Ned are taking in the story...
“Kinda.”
So you’re saying the murder weapon’s a life-
size human doll.
That’s what I’m sayin’.
(to Chuck)
You got a phone number, sweetie?
Do you mind? What about friggin’ Tina?
I’m dead, ain’t I?
No.
(touches him, he slumps)
Now you’re dead.
Chuck and Emerson look at Ned:
Oh my gosh.
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT ONE 13.
CONTINUED:
What? It was a minute. I’m having a hard day.
As they slide the body back--
That was a crime of passion.
(then)
Tina was framed. We gotta find this doll.
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT TWO 14.

scenes.heading: INT. BURLY BRUCE’S APARTMENT - HALLWAY - DAY

lines.text: Ned, Emerson and Chuck stand outside the low-rent apartment
door. SFX of dogs barking, people arguing. Emerson knocks--
Mr. Carter? Mr. Bruce Carter?
Shouldn’t we just go to the police?
The dude’s in denial. We’re gonna help Bruce
tell the truth and find this doll he used to
kill Tony DiNapoli.
What if he actually does believe his doll is a
real person? Maybe that is his truth and it’s
just different from our truth.
Truth isn’t like puppies, bunch of different
ones running around everywhere and you pick your
favorite. One truth. And it’s come a-knocking.
He knocks again...
But... let’s say he does have his own truth-
puppy, and he’s grown attached to it. Marry
that to a short fuse on a violent temper, and
what you get is--
The door opens. Burly Bruce is a BIG, MEAN-looking guy.
NED / CHUCK
Frig...
What do you want?
As the investigator and his partners wondered
where one might hide a girlfriend full of hot
air...
OLIVE IN A CLOUD OF STEAM at the espresso machine.
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT TWO 15.
CONTINUED:
...Olive found herself in a cloud of steamed
milk and self pity, unaware of the warm breath
blowing out of the mouth of Alfredo Aldarisio.
REVEAL Alfredo behind her at the counter, TALKING to her,
although we can’t hear a word because of the hissing steam.
(NOTE: The Pie Hole is still empty.) MOVE IN ON Alfredo till we
can we hear--
...because a traveling salesman isn’t such a
thing if he does not travel. As any non-
traditional-remedy salesman knows, resistance
to the novel and unconventional is marbled
through this country like gristle. If I am not
cutting that gristle, I am not doing my job.
Olive finishes steaming, turns back, serves the coffee...
(NOTE: This is the cup that Olive will pick up in Scene 69.)
Were you talking?
I am going back on the road soon. It may be a
long time before I return.
Can I ask you a question?
Of course.
She leans in. He brightens.
If you loved me...
(”where is this going?”)
Yes...
But we could never, ever, ever touch. Wouldn’t
you eventually get over it and move on, letting
someone else have the smallest glimmer of hope
that you might move on to them?
If I loved you...
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT TWO 16.
CONTINUED: (2)
Yes...
(matter-of-fact)
Then I would love you in any way I could. And
if we could not touch, then I would draw
strength from your beauty. And if I went blind,
then I would fill my soul with the sound of your
voice and the content of your thoughts till the
last spark of my love for you lit the shabby
darkness of my dying mind.
A brief moment, then:
Forget it.
Not what she wanted to hear. He watches her walk away--
The Mod Squad talks to Bruce in his modest living room.
That crazy broad Tina trying to pin this on
me? ‘Cause she came in screamin’. Said
Tony’d been fooling around on her. Then she
leapt on him like a cat. It was over before
it started. The evidence backs me up.
On that subject--
Chuck throws up a hand to stop Emerson from talking--
Mr. Carter, you’re a big, tough guy. I don’t
doubt you could make mincemeat out of all of us,
if what you needed was more mincemeat. But I
wouldn’t expect your shoes by the door or
daffodils on the table or the smell of garlic
pasta cooking in the kitchen.
Maybe I got a girlfriend. That so hard to
believe? Sheila’s got nothing to do with this.
Bruce is getting antsy...
When you say, “Sheila”--
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT TWO 17.
CONTINUED:
Ned flies up his hand to silence Emerson...
Mr. Carter, did Sheila witness the murder of
Tony DiNapoli?
No. I’m done talking. You need to leave now.
If she saw or... did something, we understand
you’d want to protect her, keep her out of it.
You love her.
(Unseen by Bruce) Emerson rolls his eyes. Bruce pauses.
(cracking)
It wasn’t Sheila’s fault, okay? It was mine.
Take me. I never should have put her in that
situation.
Big Burly Bruce starts to cry...
It’s all right, Burly Bruce. Let it out.
(looks at the closet)
Sheila, baby. You can come out. The jig’s up.
They all look at the closet door. Nothing happens.
BRUCE (CONT’D)
Sheila?
(then)
She’s probably too scared.
Uh-huh.
The information Emerson Cod gave the police...
A cuffed Burly Bruce Carter, holding a plaque with his name “Burly
Bruce Carter” and his prisoner number, looking angry, has his
photos taken. Faces forward. FLASH. Turns to the side. FLASH.
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT TWO 18.
CONTINUED:
...led to further investigation of Tony
DiNapoli’s real murder due to unreal
circumstances.
The door slides open and Tina is led out by a GUARD.
Tina Arongino was released.
ANOTHER GUARD leads Bruce in as the door slams shut again. He
grabs the bars, frenzied--
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
Burly Bruce Carter was detained by local
authorities, awaiting his trial.
SHEILA! I love you! Wait for me!
Sheila, a life-size doll, wearing a smart suit, is zipped up by
a POLICEMAN, in a body bag marked “EVIDENCE” in big letters.
Sheila the Doll was also detained.
OMIT
Olive stands in front of the bustling candy store, watching the
CUSTOMERS enter and exit with bags and buckets of sweets...
Olive, having been detained by her own angry
thoughts for long enough, had escaped to
sample something sweeter.
She enters--
Olive comes in the door to find a WOMAN wearing a HAT in the
shape of a wrapped piece of taffy is handing out individual
buckets of candy while welcoming people inside. He wears a
“Bitter Much?” button.
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT TWO 19.
CONTINUED:
She grabs the bucket and pushes through the crowd to the GLASS
CASE/COUNTER filled with trays of freshly-made candies,
chocolates and taffies. Billy, in a candy-striper outfit, and
caramel-apple HAT on top of his head, sees Olive--
Welcome! Bitter much?
I’m sorry?
The sweets are sweeter when you have a bite o’
the bitter. Welcome to Balsam’s BitterSweets
Taffy and Sweets Emporium!
(indicates his button)
Bitter much?
Yes, actually, bitter very much.
(recognizing)
Aren’t you “Some Guy”?
You’re a Pieholer!
(extends his hand)
Billy Balsam. Co-owner.
As Olive shakes...
CHUCK AND NED
Push through the crowd up next to Olive. Chuck carries a Pie
Hole pie box.
I thought we should bring a pie. That’s what
you do when you get new neighbors.
Isn’t that sweet? You’re so sweet. A gal could
get the diabetes just standing next to you.
Hey, Dilly! It’s some other small business
owners from down the street.
Who’s Dilly?
Bitter much?
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT TWO 20.
CONTINUED: (2)
Ned, Chuck and Olive turn to see--
DILLY BALSAM
The owner and proprietor of BitterSweets, looking fabulous in
her BitterSweets candy-queen uniform.
Pieholers, I’d like you to meet my sister, and
the queen of candy, Dilly Balsam.
The crowd expectantly turns to Ned.
Hi, I’m Ned.
He’s Lord of the Pies.
Ned smiles, embarrassed. Olive rolls her eyes.
Of course -- the pie place with the quaint
crust roof. I do hope Billy apologized for
all this commotion today.
If by “apologized” you mean pretended to be
someone he’s not to lure us into your sugar
shack.
Actually, it’s nice to see some excitement in
the neighborhood.
I’m so glad you see it that way. Do you like
excitement, pie man?
The Pie-Maker did not like excitement, but he
knew to be polite to a new neighbor.
I feel excitement is so much better than a lot
of things.
Do you know what I find exciting? Competition.
Hope you’re not afraid of a little competition.
Oh, I don’t really see us as competitors.
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT TWO 21.
CONTINUED: (3)
A WOMAN approaches them, breathes deep, nods to Chuck’s pie box.
Is what’s in that box the amazing smell I’m
smelling?
Is what you’re smelling Georgia peach cobbler?
That’s exactly it!
Her enthusiasm draws the attention of a few OTHER CUSTOMERS.
Then consider me the guilty Georgia peach.
It’s from the Pie Hole ‘cross the street. As
in “shut your,” but one sweet whiff and people
usually wanna “open their.”
(turns to her FRIEND)
That sounds delicious. Let’s go.
The woman leaves. Chuck offers up the pie box to Dilly.
Sorry, this is for you. Happy Grand Opening.
Hmm. That was interesting. I admire your
s... s... s... s... trategy.
Dilly has started to stutter, her nature becoming more agitated--
Strategy?
Sorry, my sister stutters when she gets upset.
Why is she upset?
(to Dilly)
Why are you upset?
Pretty nerve-y bringing your p-p-pie all up in
my business. Stealing my c-c-customers.
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT TWO 22.
CONTINUED: (4)
The other customers notice, begin to exit... Ned, Chuck and
Olive start to back up...
I really think this is a misunderstanding.
If you want a w-w-ar, that’s what you’ll get.
(getting nervous)
A war? No. A war is what we don’t want. We
came over to say h... h... hello.
Are you making f... f... fun of me?
(singsong Pig Latin)
She’s eeking-out fray...
(to Olive)
What?
Freaking out.
Dilly hears this--
You haven’t seen anything! Aim-on G-g-g-Gay!
What?!
Game on.
Game on?
Game on!
(then)
Now get out!

That ought to shake ‘em up. I liked the

PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT TWO 23.
CONTINUED: (5)
Amateurs. We’ll have ‘em out of business in a

PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT THREE 24.
FADE IN:

Chuck, Olive and Ned.

(MORE)
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT THREE 25.
CONTINUED:
I can be quite a resource for you on Ned. If

Really?
(forced smile, faux
reassuring)
No.
Where’s Alfredo?

For good?
Olive turns--
Why do you want me to care?
He really liked you.
Wouldn’t it just rock and roll if liking

Chuck watches Olive move off to serve a refill of coffee to

PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT THREE 26.

Surprise!

scenes.heading: INT. PIE HOLE - KITCHEN - MOMENTS LATER

lines.text: Ned, Chuck and Olive watch as Andrew looks around, marking
things down on his score card.
(re: Ned)
Effective hair restraints not worn...
He sees Digby nearby chomping on a bone--
ANDREW BROWN (CONT’D)
Live animal present in facility’s food area...
He moves to a PADLOCKED STORAGE ROOM DOOR. Ned knows they’re
screwed.
ANDREW BROWN (CONT’D)
You need to open this.

(then)
No, I can’t. But you should definitely wait,
anyway.

Yes, we do. I do. Sometimes.
Open the door, please.
As he does...
Olive Snook was unaware that the Pie-Maker could

PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT THREE 27.
CONTINUED:
Ned reluctantly undoes the lock and opens the door--
ANGLE - THE STORAGE ROOM
Shelves and shelves full of the stuff.
Why is this room filled with rotten fruit?
Ned, Chuck and Olive look on from inside as Brown tacks up--
A SIGN -- “NOTICE: Closed by Order of the Health Department.”
They watch the inspector walk away.
That inspection was no accident. We’re being

I don’t retaliate. I am not a retaliator.
You let your emotions get away from you and

You really believe that?
Yes. I’ve seen it happen.

That’s exactly what I’m talking about. No

They eye her cautiously.

PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT THREE 28.
CONTINUED:
You’re not welcome here.

DILLY (CONT’D)
I wanted to apologize for my outburst

(eyes Olive and Chuck)
Thank you.

A moment.
She’s doing it again.
You need to leave.
Oh, come on, we all know the world of small

Call me old-fashioned, but I like to win.
There’s plenty of customers for both of us,
Dilly. Why can’t we both win?
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT THREE 29.
CONTINUED: (2)
Because I like your crust roof, your square

Olive gasps.
You didn’t come by to apologize at all, did you?

What I see I want. What I want I take.
(then)
Nothing scares me. I’ve looked death in the eye

Yeah, actually.
(then)
Not the “candy franchise” part--

Dilly smiles...

What is up with that witch?
What was up with that witch was this: Dilania
“Dilly” Balsam...
OMIT
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT THREE 30.
TIGHT ON DILLY’S FACE
...was the daughter of two army drill

PULL OUT TO REVEAL
Dilly, clad in the same green dress and fur coat Tippi Hedren

NARRATOR (CONT’D)

NARRATOR (CONT’D)
Then, just as she was about to reach the other

DILLY SCREAMS as WHAM! A BIRD suddenly and viciously strikes

OMIT
INSERT - TIGHT ON A WRAPPED PIECE OF TAFFY

As the sweet taste of victory melted in her

And Balsam’s BitterSweets Taffy and Sweets

SPIN to see ACROSS THE STREET and push in through a window to--

Their expressions delicately suggest “yes.”
NED (CONT’D)
No. You let your anger win and engage with a

People say, “Hey, look at those two crazy

But if you don’t engage, then people say,
“Hey, look at that crazy person eating that

Still preferable.
No, it’s not preferable. She needs a dose of

Chuck, don’t go to the dark side. Revenge never

He’s gone... The girls stay with Emerson.
What do we do, Emerson?
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT THREE 32.
CONTINUED:

(then, like a hot bath)
But it feels sooooooo gooood...
He picks up his newspaper, starts to read. Chuck and Olive look

(behind his paper)

As Emerson turns and looks out the window...
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT FOUR 33.
FADE IN:
Chuck and Olive CLAD ALL IN BLACK, wearing gloves and carrying

CHUCK (CONT’D)

PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT FOUR 34.
CONTINUED:

For Ned.

NED
Stands behind the intruder, a candlestick held high, flips on

PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT FOUR 36.
CONTINUED:
NED (CONT’D)

(then, quickly)
You know, she’s pretty great, doesn’t back

PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT FOUR 38.
CONTINUED:
He climbs up the steps of the LARGE TAFFY VAT, peers down inside

Gross.
Ned tries to use the mechanical hand to fish out the creature,

NED (CONT’D)
Not good.
Something large, and alive, writhes inside the taffy. Ned

Mmmf.

lines.text: Ned, clad in an orange prison jumpsuit, sits on one side of the

Chuck, this place is crawling with police.

It’s a broad generalization, but my guess is

Without the Pie-Maker and with little to go on,

Emerson and Chuck stand before the slid-out drawer holding the

PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT FIVE 41.

Of what?
Sugar decay?

What’s that?
Cuttin’ the sucka open. I gotta do an autopsy.
Oooh.

As the coroner dons a face mask and guns the bone saw, we...

PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT FIVE 42.

Emerson’s at the counter drinking coffee and talking on the

Got it.
(hangs up)
Nobody gave a damn enough about Billy Balsam

Chuck holds up her finger like Emerson did.
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT FIVE 43.

How did you know?
Know what?
About the finger.
I learned it early on. It’s sorta the

Oh. Well it must also be the “Billy Balsam bit

(covering disgust)
No way. A real finger?
Way.
Then all we gotta do is lift a print off that

Footloose and finger-free.

PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT FIVE 44.

The Pie-Maker considered how not telling Chuck

(under his breath)
Chuck.

Something happened at that dinner. I don’t

We had so much in common. We’d talked for

BURLY BRUCE’S APARTMENT - ANOTHER DAY
Sheila (the real girl) and Bruce sit on the couch watching TV,

And before you know it, she was basically living

BACK TO SCENE (PRISON)
Bruce takes a breath--

fall for her.
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT FIVE 47.
CONTINUED:
The Pie-Maker considered the lie his cellmate
was living...
(delicate)
I know you love Sheila, but... maybe this is a
chance to move on. Find someone else...
Someone... full of life.
Sheila’s my girlfriend. I don’t care if they
don’t parole me for eighty years. I’ll find
her again.
The truth could knock all it wanted, but Burly
Bruce would never open the door. And maybe
that was for the best.
I’m sure Sheila will still be there, Bruce,
waiting for you.
Bruce smiles, hopeful...
17 miles away...
Emerson and Chuck sit in a booth.
...the search to finger the fingerless killer
of Billy Balsam continued.
No missing-digit emergencies in any of the
local hospitals last night.
Maybe the killer doesn’t realize they lost a
finger, so they never went to the hospital.
That would narrow down our suspects to
insanely stupid people.
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT FIVE 48.
CONTINUED:
Some amputees have phantom limbs. They think
the severed body part is still there even when
it’s not. It’s a psychological protection
mechanism people use to deal with the trauma.
He stares at her a beat...
We need to go back to BitterSweets. We need
to get into the scene of the crime.
How’re we gonna get past Dilly?
CLOSE ON - OLIVE
Hiya.
DILLY
Wearing her mittens and standing in front of BitterSweets
sweeping the sidewalk. The door is still broken, with police
“DO NOT CROSS CRIME SCENE” tape over the opening.
You got a lot of spunk, coming back here.
I’m surprised you’re here.
It’s what Billy would want.
Can I talk to you for a minute? In private?
Dilly sets her broom against the wall, starts inside...
OLIVE (CONT’D)
I mean private, outside-private.
Olive guides her down the block as, unseen by Dilly, CHUCK AND
EMERSON SNEAK AROUND AND ENTER BITTERSWEETS.
Chuck and Emerson enter and begin to look around with URGENCY.
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT FIVE 49.
CONTINUED:
This dude bit off somebody’s finger and he was
found face-up in the taffy, which means--
That he probably wasn’t attacked from behind.
Right.
So there had to be a struggle.
Emerson kneels down next to the LARGE, MARBLE-SLABBED CANDY
TABLE in the middle of the room.
I’d say more like a full-on brawl.
Chuck joins him.
EMERSON (CONT’D)
This table’s been moved.
Emerson points to the SCRATCH MARKS ON THE FLOOR underneath the
table’s legs. They stand up and look at the empty marble top.
Chuck grabs a SACK OF POWDERED SUGAR and SPRINKLES IT OVER THE
MARBLE.
EMERSON (CONT’D)
Wrong kitchen.
Chuck moves to a large rack of baking utensils and picks up a
candy brush.
Marble is a very interesting stone. It’s
resistant to grease and oils which leave stains
if it’s not cleaned properly and right away. So,
if someone were to put their hands on it, say...
Chuck begins to wipe away the excess sugar delicately with the
candy brush.
In the heat of a scuffle...
Chuck finishes brushing and steps away...
The oils from their hands would leave an
imprint on the surface.
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT FIVE 50.
CONTINUED: (2)
ANGLE - THE MARBLE TOP
Where we see a POWDERED SUGAR-DUSTED IMPRINT OF TWO HANDS, BUT
ONLY NINE FINGERS.
RESUME - CHUCK AND EMERSON - AS BEFORE
Two hands.
Nine fingerprints.
One taffy-drowning murderer.
Emerson grabs a LARGE SHEET OF FRUIT ROLL-UP CANDY from a drying
rack and lays it on the marble. He gently presses down, then
peels it away.
ANGLE - FRUIT ROLL UP, showing that the sugar hand-prints have
been lifted onto its sticky surface. He looks at Chuck.
EMERSON (CONT’D)
Nice work.
You, too.
Olive talks to Dilly -- Dilly’s back is to the store’s front
door...
So I just want you to know that even though we
got off on the wrong foot, we are still your
neighbors and we’re here for you. I realize we
may not always wave or smile when we see each
other for a while because of... events that have
occurred--
I broke your sign and called a city health
inspector hotline and you all killed my brother.
So we agree to disagree on that...
Dilly, annoyed, sighs and NOTICES SOMETHING in her ADJACENT
PARKED CAR’S SIDE MIRROR:
DILLY’S POV - SIDE MIRROR
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT FIVE 51.
CONTINUED:
Emerson pokes his head out the front door of BitterSweets and
looks around, then pops back in.
RESUME - DILLY AND OLIVE
You want proof? You want me to show you something
that proves exactly what happened to Billy?
Dilly produces a set of car keys, pushes the FOB. Her CAR BEEPS
and the trunk pops open. Dilly strides with a purpose, Olive
running behind, to look in the--
TRUNK - it is empty.
What? It’s an empty car trunk?
No, it’s not.
Dilly PUSHES OLIVE INTO THE TRUNK AND SLAMS IT CLOSED...
OLIVE (O.S.)
(from inside)
Oh, crap!
Dilly reaches behind her and removes A GUN from her waistband.
As Dilly heads inside her store...
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT SIX 52.
Emerson and Chuck are faced off against Dilly, her still-
mittened hand training a gun on them.
(under her breath)
Her hands. She’s wearing mittens.
Put the gun down, lady.
The pie-making murderer didn’t finish the job
so he sent his girlfriend and the muscle to
finish me off?
Ned didn’t kill anyone, and you know it.
We’re just trying to find out the truth.
The only truth you need to know is I miss my
brother.
Dilly raises the gun, tries to get her fingers to the trigger,
but the mittens make it impossible. Frustrated, she RIPS THE
MITTENS OFF and throws them to the ground, revealing her hands
and their TEN INTACT FINGERS.
You’ve got ten fingers!
You’re not the killer!
Emerson holds up the fruit roll-up.
And I don’t think you want to be one either.
Let us take the evidence to the authorities.
We’ll find out who really killed your brother.
A beat, as Dilly considers, then slowly lowers the gun.
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT SIX 53.
CONTINUED:
All right, I’ll let you go. If you can put
whoever killed my brother behind bars, I’ll be
happy. I thought I wanted revenge, but all I
really need is j-j-justice.
She returns to her sweeping. Chuck and Emerson turn and head
for the door.
Did she just--
Yep.
Dilly produces her CAR REMOTE FOB again. We hear the BOOP-BOOP
as it unlocks.
And take your trunk monkey with you!
As Emerson and Chuck leave...
The facts were these...
Dilly’s trunk pops open.
After Olive was freed from Dilly Balsam’s
trunk...
Olive’s eyes squint, adjusting to the blinding sun of freedom.
(yells)
ATTICA!!!
CAMERA PANS OVER TO A HEAD AND TORSO X-RAY OF BILLY BALSAM. The
coroner’s finger comes into frame and he points...
The authorities explained that the time it would
take for the dismembered digit to pass through
the digestive system of Billy Balsam...
The coroner traces the path of the finger through the body...
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT SIX 54.
CONTINUED:
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
...and have its fingerprint erased by the acid
contained in the stomach, put the time of death
of one Billy Balsam hours earlier than the time
the Pie-Maker was found hovering over body.
THE CORONER AND EMERSON - LATER
The coroner peers into a microscope at the fruit roll-up...
Fingerprint analysis of the sheet of candy
fruit exposed the 9-fingered culprit to be
none other than...
ANDREW BROWN, pulling out his clipboard...
...Andrew Brown, Health Inspector.
Dilly’s being questioned by a couple of POLICE OFFICERS.
Whom it was revealed, upon further investigation,
had been blackmailing Dilly and Billy Balsam.
PIE HOLE - KITCHEN (AS PREVIOUSLY SEEN - SCENE 27)
Andrew Brown opens the closet, revealing the rotten fruit.
Having paid off the inspector to conduct a
surprise inspection that led to the Pie Hole’s
temporary shutdown...
PIE HOLE - FRONT DOOR (AS PREVIOUSLY SEEN - SCENE 28)
The “Closed by Order of the Health Department” notice is tacked
to the Pie Hole’s door.
...Brown had demanded a bribe lest he reveal
Billy and Dilly’s dastardly deed and shut them
down, too.

scenes.heading: INT. BITTERSWEETS - PRODUCTION ROOM - NIGHT - FLASHBACK

lines.text: Billy and Andrew Brown are seen arguing.
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT SIX 55.
CONTINUED:
Unwilling to be bullied, Billy Balsam balked.
The fight becomes physical. Brown gets the upper hand and we
see Billy’s mouth open wide and bite down as Brown screams in
agony. Brown puts his (now nine-fingered) hand down on the
marble table and pushes back with all his might, sending Billy
flying backward where he falls into the taffy machine and gets
sucked under. As we PUSH IN on Brown’s FACE...
CLOSE ON A TELEVISION SCREEN where BROWN’S PICTURE is now part
of a news report.
(on the screen)
Health Inspector Andrew Brown is now believed to
be the number-one suspect in the murder of
Balsam’s BitterSweets Taffy and Sweets Emporium
co-owner, Billy Balsam.
CAMERA FINDS Chuck and Olive watching the news.
ON THE SCREEN
Emerson’s PICTURE behind the anchor...
NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
Thanks to the work of Private Investigator
Emerson Cod, the owner of the local Pie Hole was
cleared of all charges and released from jail.
Authorities are conducting and extensive search
for Andrew Brown, who remains at large. Next
up: Can apes drive? We’ll find out.
THE BELL OVER THE DOOR CHIMES, OLIVE AND CHUCK SPIN AND SEE--
NED AND EMERSON
Olive squeals.
Dead girl walking.
Ned smiles at the sight of her.
Walking right toward me.
As Chuck reaches him:
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT SIX 56.
CONTINUED:
You okay?
Sure. I mean, I am now. Thanks for getting
me sprung.
You’re welcome. I had some help.
Olive hops up on a table and gives him a hug.
CHUCK (CONT’D)
That hug goes double for me.
Ned smiles at Olive, who moves off. He moves to Emerson, who’s
getting ready to go.
You know, doing this work without you actually
means doing a whole lotta work. Not that I
can’t, ‘cause I can. But I don’t like it.
Glad to be back.
(then)
It wasn’t all bad in jail, you know. I had a
lot of time to think. And I made a decision.
Ned looks at Chuck, safely out of earshot...
NED (CONT’D)
Everyone talks about how the truth will set you
free. But Burly Bruce was free to love someone
‘cause he was so good at lying to himself about
the doll being real. Which is to say, go lying!
Or at least, yay to not telling the truth. I’m
not telling Chuck about her dad.
I hear that as if it came right from my very
own mouth. Oh, wait, it did.
Well you were right. Good night.
Night.
Emerson exits. Ned joins Chuck at the counter. Olive serves
them each a slice of pie (including herself).
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT SIX 57.
CONTINUED: (2)
Safely home and cleared of having committed
any crime, the Pie-Maker enjoyed a celebratory
piece of pie and went up to bed.
DISSOLVE TO:
Olive and Chuck are putting chairs up on the tables, closing up
for the night.
I think we’re ready to open for business in
the morning.
Spick-and-span.
Thanks for everything, Olive. Couldn’t have
saved Ned without you.
Olive goes back to her work...
Ain’t no thing but a chicken wing.
You okay?
I’m great.
(then)
Or I will be.
Chuck hesitates, wants to say more, then:
Night.
Chuck exits out the back. Olive moves down the counter, picks
up Alfredo’s coffee cup, then looks at the door. IT FLIES OPEN--
ALFREDO
Steps in--
Olive.
Fredo. I knew it was you.
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT SIX 58.
CONTINUED:
She runs to him. He sweeps her off her feet and kisses her
deeply...
Sometimes, a crime of passion is not realizing
the passion in time.
SMASH CUT TO:
Olive, back at the counter, still holding the cup. The kiss
never happened. Olive takes the cup and turns to head in back,
this time with melancholy...
Bruce is on his cot staring out the window.
While other times the crime is not seeing the
world as it is.
Dilly stands at the edge of a swamp, next to an empty
wheelbarrow.
But most crimes of passion...
CAMERA PANS DOWN as the four-fingered hand of Andrew Brown slips
down into the muck.
NARRATOR (CONT’D)
...are actually a crime.
Dilly wipes her hands off on her apron, turns and walks away,
pushing the wheelbarrow.
Ned and Chuck climb into bed, both exhausted from the day.
So people can actually feel their limbs even
after they’re gone?
Yup. Some do.
It’s weird, but I kinda like it.
PUSHING DAISIES #107 "Bitter Sweets" 10/25/07 FINAL DRAFT ACT SIX 59.
CONTINUED:
Me, too.
While I was in jail... I think you were my
phantom limb.
I was?
You were. It was like you were there with me
the whole time.
I’m so glad you’re back.
Chuck smiles.
The Pie-Maker had never felt closer to another
person as he did at that moment. He felt a
rush of emotion overcome him...
Chuck?
Mm-hmm...
...causing one crime of passion that came in
the form of a confession.
I killed your dad.
